title: Improper Neutralization of Input During Web Page Generation ('Cross-site Scripting') vulnerability in WPExperts Gutena…
description: A stored cross-site scripting (XSS) vulnerability exists in WPExperts Gutena Forms (Contact Form, Survey Form, Feedback Form, Booking Form, and Custom Form Builder) up to version 2.1.1. This vulnerability allows improper neutralization of input during web page generation, potentially enabling attackers to inject malicious scripts. The vulnerability has a CVSS score of 6.5, indicating a medium severity level.
